title: Platinum Rewards Card: Free Virtual Cards - How to Create and Manage
summary: This document explains how to create and manage free virtual cards included with a Platinum Rewards Card account, including keeping up to 30 active virtual cards at a time. It covers creation steps (nickname, spending limit, merchant lock), how to copy card number/expiry/security code, and how to pause/unpause, edit, delete/replace, plus best practices for merchant/subscription tracking and limit management.
